::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 1862  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. This fragment printed in Mary J. Y. Harris, <i>[Memoirs of Frances Mary Peard](other_books/otherbook_318.qmd)</i> (1903), 47.
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1160.qmd),[^1]

. . . . .

Yours much obliged, 

C. M. Yonge 

P.S., I daresay you may know my name as a Devonshire one, I am a niece of [Mr. Yonge](people/person_1623.qmd) of Puslinch.

---

[^1]: Harris writes that the letter contained a request that Miss Peard should send her a paper on the Jewish Sects for the *[Monthly Paper of Sunday Teaching](organizations/other_81.qmd)*.
